article_title: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark

tasks.prompt: How does the new Greenland deal address the dispute between the US, Denmark and Greenland?
options: It expands US military access while affirming Danish sovereignty and Greenlandic self-determination
It transfers ownership of Greenland to the US
It removes Greenland from Nato immediately
It closes every existing military facility on the island
tasks.correct_answer: It expands US military access while affirming Danish sovereignty and Greenlandic self-determination
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההסכם מרחיב את הנוכחות הצבאית האמריקנית אך אינו מעביר שטח, ומכיר בריבונות דנמרק ובזכות גרינלנד להגדרה עצמית.

tasks.prompt: Where may the US establish the two additional defence areas?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההסכם מתיר אזורי הגנה נוספים בנרסרסואק שבדרום ובמסטרסוויג שבמזרח.

tasks.prompt: What does “unfettered” mean when the article says US security arrangements are not unfettered?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: unfettered פירושו ללא מגבלות; כאן נדרש עדיין אישור דנמרק וגרינלנד לפרטים.

tasks.prompt: What does “climb down” mean in the assessment of Trump's position?
options: A journey from a mountain base
A retreat from an earlier, stronger demand
tasks.correct_answer: A retreat from an earlier, stronger demand
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר נסיגה מן הדרישות הקודמות לרכוש או לספח את גרינלנד.

tasks.prompt: What does the agreement say about non-Nato countries in Greenland?
options: They may not establish military installations or maintain a persistent military presence
They may build bases with US approval alone
They will operate Pituffik Space Base
They automatically join Nato if they invest there
tasks.correct_answer: They may not establish military installations or maintain a persistent military presence
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההסכם אוסר על מדינות שאינן חברות נאט״ו להקים מתקנים צבאיים או נוכחות צבאית מתמשכת.

tasks.prompt: What does “ceded” mean in the statement that no territory is ceded to the US?
options: Transferred or surrendered to another country
tasks.correct_answer: Transferred or surrendered to another country
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ceded פירושו נמסר או מועבר לריבונות אחרת; הכתבה מדגישה שלא הועבר שטח לארה״ב.

tasks.prompt: Describe two limits or approval requirements placed on the expanded US presence.
expected_points: Technical details and operating arrangements must be mutually agreed
Denmark and Greenland retain approval over implementation
No territory is transferred to the US
The deal still requires approval by both the Danish and Greenlandic parliaments
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי מגבלות או דרישות אישור מן הכתבה, ולא לטעון שלארה״ב ניתנה שליטה בלתי מוגבלת.

tasks.prompt: Why can the agreement be presented as a success by all three parties despite their earlier conflict?
expected_points: The US gains two defence areas and may expand Pituffik activities
Denmark's sovereignty and territorial integrity are reaffirmed
Greenland's self-determination and role in decisions are recognised
The deal may ease tensions and strengthen Nato security
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג אינטרס נפרד של ארה״ב ושל דנמרק או גרינלנד, ולהבחין בין הישג מדיני לבין אישור פרלמנטרי שעדיין נדרש.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the new defence deal, its background and the remaining steps before it takes full effect.
expected_points: The US, Denmark and Greenland signed an update to the 1951 defence agreement
It permits new defence areas at Narsarsuaq and Mestersvig and expansion at Pituffik
It follows tensions caused by Trump's earlier threats to acquire Greenland
It affirms sovereignty, territorial integrity and self-determination
The Danish and Greenlandic parliaments must still approve it
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב סיכום באנגלית המבדיל בין מה שנחתם, מה שעדיין אינו מפורט ומה שדורש אישור נוסף.

tasks.prompt: Explain why the article describes the deal as both a US strategic gain and a retreat from Trump's earlier position.
expected_points: The US receives a stronger military presence in a strategically important Arctic region
It can develop two bases and modernise Pituffik
Non-Nato military presence is explicitly barred
The US receives no territory or sovereignty
The agreement recognises Denmark and Greenland's rights and needs mutual approval
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב פסקה מאוזנת באנגלית עם ראיות לשני צדי ההערכה, בלי לתאר טענה פרשנית כעובדה מוסכמת.
